notes.title: about the issue of not being able to buy in some Contry
notes.notes:
The game was finally approved and released, but after a short period of joy, we found that the steampage could not be opened in come country. We have not found any area related settings in Steam Developer Console, we are contacting STEAM customer service... It is too much trouble.
Guessing it is related to adult content review?.. I hope it can be resolved as soon as possible, headache

notes.title: Submission status update
notes.notes:
Today I received a call back message from STEAM (10 days later, finally...), which means that our game contains adult content, but we selected no adult content when setting up the game, so we were called back...
At present, adult content has been set up as required, and a certain description has been made (you can see it on the STEAM page)
I thought we weren’t adult content... well, I’m still too young. I didn’t expect it
I have submitted it again, I hope this time it will go smoothly,
At the same time, thank you very much for your attention!

notes.title: Postponement announcement
notes.notes:
Since it is our first Steam game, we are very unfamiliar with the Steam launch process...Currently, the game is still in Steam review, and the review time has exceeded our expectations (we thought it could be reviewed in 1-2 days)
At present, the game has been in review for almost a week... I hope that there will be good news soon, and we will release it as soon as the game passes.
Thank you very much to everyone who followed, and very sorry for the postponement
